subject: Proactive on-call shadowing proposal to cover EU night P1/P2 windows
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom@greenbridge.health>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Support response during EU night window

Hi Marissa,

We've seen two P1 incidents in the last 2 weeks that crossed our night window (22:00-06:00 CET) and response times have been longer than in our SLA. The issues were brief (service fallback) but our on-call rota shows no shadowing for EU nights and that contributed to the delay.

Can Redwood recommend a short-term operational workaround while we coordinate a longer-term headcount fix? We're open to a temporary delegation, a bridge lead, or shadowing from other regions — anything that reduces time-to-first-response for P1s and P2s.

Ideally we'd like a one-week pilot starting Nov 16 if possible. Please advise next steps and any docs you need from us.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of IT Operations
Greenbridge Health

--

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom@greenbridge.health>, Sophie Lim <sophie@greenbridge.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Support response during EU night window

Tom — thanks for the clear summary. Sorry to hear about the delays.

Short answer: yes, we can put a short pilot in place that minimizes risk to your production and demonstrates measurable improvements for P1/P2 first-response times. I propose the following lightweight plan:

- Pilot objective: reduce median time-to-first-response for P1 incidents to < 15 minutes during 22:00-06:00 CET for one week.
- Mechanism: EU-night "shadowing" where a designated Redwood bridge lead is assigned visibility into Greenbridge alerts and is paged for P1s; existing Greenbridge on-call remains primary.
- Staffing: Redwood will assign a bridge lead and a backup from our EU-capable roster. Shadowing is advisory with escalation authority only when Greenbridge on-call is unresponsive for a configured threshold.
- Escalation path: 1) Greenbridge on-call; 2) Redwood bridge lead (shadow) after 12 minutes; 3) Redwood duty manager (Ben) at 30 minutes if unresolved.
- Metrics & exit criteria: time-to-first-response, ack rate, and a short post-pilot retrospective.

I'll need: your on-call contact list, escalation matrix, and any PagerDuty (or Opsgenie) share link. I've looped in Ben (cc) to confirm capacity and oversights.

If that sounds acceptable I can draft a two-page pilot MOU and a shadowing template for sign-off. Proposed pilot start Nov 16 — let me know if that works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: oncall_shadowing_template.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Hargreaves <tom@greenbridge.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Support response during EU night window

Marissa / Tom — I reviewed capacity with the team. We can cover a 1-week shadowing pilot starting Nov 16. A couple operational notes:

- We will provide a named bridge lead + one backup per night (rota attached). Bridge lead will have read-only access to Greenbridge PagerDuty and will be paged on P1s/P2s with the thresholds Marissa listed.
- Escalation authority: Redwood will not change incident ownership — we only step in as escalation after the configured window. We need Greenbridge approval on the 12-minute threshold (configurable).
- Logging & audit: we'll keep a short incident log and share a post-pilot CSV.

Laura — can you confirm the EU roster PDF and upload the roster link to the shared Drive?

Tom — once we have your on-call contacts and the share link I will finalize the MOU.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Support Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: eu-night-roster-v1.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Hargreaves <tom@greenbridge.health>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Support response during EU night window

Quick update — roster uploaded and I've added a short runbook to the Drive (link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Gbh_ShadowPlan). Ben, I scheduled a 30-minute sync for Nov 15 to run through escalation examples and verify paging config.

Tom — from a compliance perspective we will only log incident metadata (timestamps, actor tagged as "Redwood bridge lead") and will not access customer data. If Greenbridge legal wants a one-line MSA addendum I can draft that language.

Looking forward to the pilot.

— Laura
Head of Customer Support Operations, Redwood Inference
